original.statement: Running Cilium with --datapath-mode=lb-only in plain Docker mode now requires adding --enable-k8s=false, otherwise Kubernetes is assumed to be present.

decision.reason: [ev-09d5e26554e5] says that running Cilium with `--datapath-mode=lb-only` in plain Docker mode "now requires" adding `--enable-k8s=false` to the command line. The subject is therefore the cli-flag `--enable-k8s`, with no specific component named in the text. The change is now-required with the value false, which matches the literal in the text.
